turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What should I eat on the morning of an exam? I usually just skip breakfast.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try not to skip it. Something with slow energy, like porridge, eggs on toast, or yogurt with fruit, keeps you going.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Miles, did the hamster escape again?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I get too nervous to eat, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then something small. A banana and a glass of milk is better than nothing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to sign up for one event this autumn to keep me motivated, and I've found a few.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you not jump in until I've covered all of them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A half marathon in the city, flat and fast, with thousands of people cheering along the route.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A muddy trail race in the forest, about fifteen kilometers, with some steep climbs and river crossings.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: An obstacle course with walls, ropes and a lot of mud, and you can enter as a team with friends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, all done. What's your gut say?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you want structure, the half marathon gives you a clear training plan and a great atmosphere. The trail race is tougher but beautiful. The obstacle course is the most fun, especially with friends, though it's less about running.
